class.name: SlugVector2D
class.brief_description: Draws a [SlugVector] (an SVG) as flat 2D UI with the Slug algorithm.
class.description: SlugVector2D draws the filled regions of a [SlugVector] in 2D directly from their Bézier outlines, so the image stays crisp at any scale. It is meant for flat UI (icons, HUD layers) where a rasterized texture would pixelate when scaled. Each region keeps the fill color authored in the SVG (or the [SlugVector] fill/stroke roles), multiplied by [member tint]. [member size] is the height in pixels of the vector's bounding box; the width follows the SVG's aspect ratio. If [member centered] is [code]true[/code] the node's origin is the center of the drawing, otherwise its top-left corner. SlugVector2D only works with the GLES3 rendering backend; under GLES2 or with a null/invalid [member vector], nothing is drawn. Up to 255 regions are supported per vector.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the node's origin is the center of the drawing; otherwise it is the top-left corner.
